query:
UPDATE scrobble_imports SET
            loved_page     = $2,
            loved_done     = $3,
            loved_total    = COALESCE(loved_total, $4),
            loved_imported = loved_imported + $5,
            loved_error    = CASE WHEN $6 THEN 'cap_reached' ELSE loved_error END,
            attempts       = 0,
            error_message  = NULL,
            leased_until   = NOW() + make_interval(secs => $7)
        WHERE id = $1
